commits.subject: Studio AE-17 (SMB-AE-EFFECT-FAMILIES-2 slices 1-4): blur, glow and colour effect families and entry blend mode / effect mask in the composition effect stack

capabilities_done: slice 1 blur: Gaussian Blur (pigment LayerBlur::taps, blurriness = pigment radius, sigma r/2, <= 1000) and Fast Box Blur (box_taps: iterated normalised box, half-width and iterations rounded half up, <= 6001 taps) through pigment blur_math::blur_window on the straight pre-entry buffer; Repeat Edge Pixels pads the source by its border texels over the support; taps [1.0] = identity bit for bit; Directional Blur (length 0), Radial Blur (amount 0), Find Edges (blend 1) lower to the identity, else refused composition_effect_kernel

slice 2 glow: bright pass by pigment AdjustmentOp::Threshold on colour or alpha (threshold v/255; 0 passes all, 255 none), blur_window, intensity in premultiplied form, Original or A&B colours (sawtooth/triangle looping, loops, midpoint), Composite Original Behind (composite_over with the Glow Operation mapped to pigment modes) / On Top / None

slice 3 colour: Levels, Hue/Saturation (master or colorize), Exposure (master or individual channels, linearize 2.2 on encoded plans unless bypass), Color Balance, Tint and Tritone (pigment gradient map + blend), Invert RGB/R/G/B, all through pigment adjust_math on straight colour, alpha kept, transparent texels unchanged

slice 4 entry semantics: Folio StudioCompositionEffect.blend_mode (canonical discriminant, default 2, pass-through/tool-only refused InvalidField .../blend_mode) and mask_id (a layer mask id, else InvalidField .../mask_id); lowered to SceneEffect::Composite: non-normal mode = W3C blended source colour Cs' = (1-ab)Cs + ab B(Cb,Cs) via pigment blend_rgb, alpha of the result; mask = coverage of the named mask alone (mode add, own inversion/feather/opacity/expansion through mask_paths::mask_coverage_shaped) multiplying the entry mix; normal without mask never wrapped (stack-1 bytes unchanged); dissolve and modes without a pigment formula refused composition_effect_option
